title: Button - Primary On Dark
description: White pill button for hero-caliber CTAs inside permanently-dark sections. Used as a real core/button for Writing CTA's "Book a consultation", and applied to core/read-more for the Blog Hero featured-article card's "Read article" link (dynamic, bound to the Query Loop's current post, same core/read-more convention as Card - Work Project's "View project"). Background/text stay constant across the light/dark style variation toggle, matching the on-dark token family. Hover contract in src/scss/animations/_button-motion.scss.
